ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 40% high-intensity (off-white) across the visible ventral area, with high-intensity pixels concentrated in the lateral mid-sections of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly elliptical high-intensity blobs occupying the central-lateral regions of the left and right lobes. These are surrounded by a continuous low-intensity boundary that thickens at the median notch and fluke tips. Small, isolated low-intensity circular clusters (mottling) are present within the high-intensity regions, particularly on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a wide interior angle (approximately 110-130 degrees) and a shallow vertical depth relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits a low-frequency, smooth undulating topography. No sharp, high-amplitude serrations are detected; the boundary transition between fluke and water is relatively continuous and rounded.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning into convex leading edges, resulting in a symmetrical, tapered wing-like geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark-pixel circular clusters (mottling) are visible against the lighter background on the left lobe, primarily localized towards the leading edge and distal tip.

other_distinctive_markers: The pigmentation pattern forms a symmetrical dark 'anchor' or 'butterfly' shape centered on the peduncle attachment and extending along the trailing edge to the tips.
